coBidding.title: Co-Bidding Pattern Detected
coBidding.description: This vendor frequently appears in the same procedures with specific partners.
coBidding.noPatternsDescription: Requires ≥3 shared competitive procedures with another vendor
coBidding.heuristicNote: This is a separate heuristic analysis. Note: co-bidding concentration (cobid_herfindahl, measured on co-award partners in years before the contract) is in the v0.9.2 risk model with coefficient −0.143: a higher concentration lowers the indicator. Raw co-bid rates shown here are a complementary view.
